Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp

Interface McpCompleter

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface McpCompleter
Application behavior invoked for a completion/complete request against a declared prompt argument (McpPromptArgument.getCompleter()) or resource-template variable (McpResourceTemplateHandler.completer(String)).

Order and duplicates in the returned values are application-owned: this SPI performs no ranking, filtering, deduplication, or pagination beyond the 100-value cap documented on McpCompletionResult.

  • Method Details

    • complete

      McpCompletionResult complete(McpCompletionRequest request, BeanStore ctx)
      Computes completion suggestions for the current value of one prompt argument or template variable.
      Parameters:
      request - The completion request. Never null.
      ctx - Per-request bean store. Never null.
      Returns:
      The completion result. A null return is an internal handler failure - see McpCompletionResult.normalize(McpCompletionResult).
